name: Alpenhotel Ernberg
beschreibung: The Alpenhotel Ernberg is located in Breitenwang on the edge of the Lech Valley, offering views of the surrounding mountains of Tyrol. The accommodation features rooms in a traditional alpine style equipped with modern amenities. The hotel's offerings include a restaurant serving regional Tyrolean cuisine as well as a wellness area with a sauna and steam bath. Its location provides direct access to hiking trails in summer and ski slopes in winter, while the nearby market town of Reutte offers extensive additional infrastructure. Guests will find a tranquil atmosphere well away from busy traffic routes, ideal for a restorative holiday. The family-run hospitality characterizes the hotel and appeals to couples and families alike.
